ingredients.name: bitter melon, halved lengthwise, seeded and sliced 1/4 inch thick
sweet potato, peeled, quartered and cut into 1/4-inch slices
string beans, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths
eggplant, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/2 inch thick
okra, caps trimmed and pods halved on the bias

steps.instruction: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the pan.
Cook the garlic briefly until fragrant.
Add 1 small chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1/4 cup of bagoong alamang and 1 pinch of salt.
steps.spoken: Add 2 chopped plum tomatoes, 1/4 cup of bagoong alamang and 1 pinch of salt. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the sliced bitter melon and the sliced sweet potato.
Cover and cook until almost, but not quite, tender.
Add the string beans, the eggplant and the okra.
Cover and cook a few minutes, until all the vegetables are tender.
